name: Raw ivar reflection reports missing, removed and invalid names

input.package_probe: let b = Box.new(); let missing = Reflection::Object.get_ivar(b, :@missing); let assigned = Reflection::Object.set_ivar(b, :@x, 7); let read = Reflection::Object.get_ivar(b, :@x); let removed = Reflection::Object.remove_ivar(b, :@x); let absent = try { Reflection::Object.remove_ivar(b, :@x) } catch e { e }; let hierarchy = try { Reflection::Object.get_ivar(b, :"@@x") } catch e { e }; let unsigiled = try { Reflection::Object.get_ivar(b, :"ready?") } catch e { e }; [missing, read, removed, absent, hierarchy, unsigiled]

applicability.reason: Pure Iris source has no native boundary.
